Priya (support): Customer reports intermittent JSON parse errors after a heavy batch: "Unexpected token '\n' in JSON at position 512". Request_id=rid_8b2c. They say retries multiplied token usage and billing.
Mei (eng-ml): Can you paste their raw output sample (redacted) so we can repro?
Priya (support): Redacted snippet below:
```
{"items":[{"id":1,"label":"ok"},
{"id":2,"label":"needs_review",}
]}
```
Priya (support): Note trailing comma after "needs_review". Customer says ~0.6% of responses fail; seems correlated with outputs >1500 tokens.
Carlos (sre): Likely generation truncation and chunk boundary issues in streaming. If a chunk boundary splits a list item, concatenation can leave a stray comma/newline. Repro plan: deterministic run (temperature=0), force token limits, and test streaming flush timings.
Mei (eng-ml): Also check reassembly logic. @infra-bot please fetch spans for rid_8b2c and other failing rids in the past day.
infra-bot: Retrieved traces for 7 request_ids, traces uploaded to s3://redwood-support-dumps/traces/rid_8b2c.json
Mei (eng-ml): Trace shows a long gap between "serialize_tokens" and "stream_flush" spans; model emitted comma+newline at chunk edge. Our reassembler naively concatenated without sentinel handling.
Jonah (product): Is this unique to structured_output mode? Could be schema drift or prompt changes. Regardless, we should harden parsing, logging, and customer-facing signals.
Carlos (sre): Observability wishlist:
- prometheus metric: structured_output_parse_errors_total{route,model,customer}
- add json_parse span with attribute parse_success (true/false) and request_id
- sample and store redacted raw outputs for failing parses at 1% rate to S3
- dashboard: parse_error_rate, json-mode tail latencies, token burn by retry count
Mei (eng-ml): Parsing fallback plan (try in order):
1) Strict JSON.parse
2) Sanitizer: fix trailing commas and stray commas before brackets/braces, collapse unescaped newlines in strings, limited regex fixes
3) If still failing, increment parse_error metric, save redacted sample, and return structured error with request_id and repro hint.
Example sanitizer snippet:
```
payload = payload.replace(/,\s*\]/g, ']')
payload = payload.replace(/,\s*\}/g, '}')
// best-effort: replace unescaped newlines inside quoted strings
```
Priya (support): Customer mitigation: ask them to use a tolerant JSON parser or fall back to /responses/text when X-Parse-Status != ok.
Jonah (product): Privacy/redaction rules for stored samples:
- mask API keys and credit cards
- hash emails and store only prefix of hash
- trim long freeform fields >1000 chars (keep head/tail)
Carlos (sre): Prometheus alert suggestion:
```
alert: HighJSONParseErrorRate
expr: (sum(rate(structured_output_parse_errors_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(api_requests_total[5m])) by (route)) > 0.005
for: 15m
```
Mei (eng-ml): Runtime mitigation: during streaming, emit an explicit end sentinel "__REDWOOD_JSON_END__" when structured_output=true so reassembler can avoid ambiguity at chunk boundaries.
Priya (support): Billing note: customer retried 12x due to client retry policy; tokens spiked ~6x baseline. We should add X-Parse-Status header: ok|sanitized|failed so clients can short-circuit retries. Support will email interim guidance and request permission to store redacted samples.
Carlos (sre): Actions:
- Mei: implement sanitizer + sentinel + json_parse span; canary deploy EOD
- Infra: add metric, dashboard, alert rule; due tomorrow
- Priya: send customer mitigation and request samples; today
- Jonah: update docs and recommended retry behavior (inspect X-Parse-Status); this week
Mei (eng-ml): I'll add unit tests and a small fuzz harness for edge-case JSON (split escapes, trailing commas, unicode boundaries).
Priya (support): Marking P1 escalation. Will update when customer OKs sample storage. :eyes:
support-bot: Ticket attached #SUP-14321. Thread labeled #json-parse-escalation.
